Axle is built with enterprise-grade security and compliance at its core—so you can deploy confidently across your entire organization

See Security Portal

SOC 2 Certified

Axle is SOC-2 Type II certified, as verified by independent audit based on standards set by the AICPA.

SSO/SAML Auth

Axle supports 20+ IdPs (Google, Okta, etc) so you can authenticate using your SSO/SAML provider.

HIPAA Compliant

Axle is fully HIPAA compliant, as verified by independent audit based on standards set by the HHS.

Penetration Tested

Axle undergoes regular penetration testing by an independent security research firm.

Data Encryption:

Axle encrypts all data in our platform in transit and at rest, using best-in-class encryption techniques.

Access Controls

Axle provides fine-grained role types and permissions to ensure users have the appropriate levels of access.

Questions?

We’ve got answers

What if my EMR already has a scheduling tool?

Axle’s advanced scheduling module complements your EMR with additional functionality, without changing any of your downstream EMR workflows.

How much does it cost?

Axle’s cost is based on your estimated savings - our team will conduct an ROI analysis for you and use that to determine the price.

Will this be hard to implement?

No - your Axle implementation manager will build a custom onboarding plan for you based on your operational and technical needs, and will configure your account, prepare custom training materials, and conduct the initial training sessions for your users until your team is ready to take over.
